architecture.main_axis: Definition -> OperationCase -> WorkItem -> CommandSubmission -> SliceCommandHandler -> DomainEvent / LedgerEntry -> ProcessManager -> Projection / Lens -> Surface
architecture.workspace_card: retired write path; projection display only

modules.architecture_authority: docs/engineering and docs/rules/v5.5 remain highest authority; docs/architecture is compatibility/reference only.
modules.admission_kernel: docs/contracts/admission plus AdmissionKernelService decide visibleAllowed, prepareAllowed, confirmAllowed, productionAllowed.
modules.operations_runtime: CanonicalOperationsApiService and OperationsUnitOfWork own the primary business write path.
modules.compatibility_box: ProjectionRuntime and Workspace/Card are quarantined compatibility facade/wrapper components.
modules.experience_kernel: Mobile and PC surfaces render runtime decisions, blockers, required fields, evidence state, and recovery guidance without writing facts.
modules.language_kernel: Language catalogs cover zh-CN, ru-RU, ky-KG domain terms, field labels, status explanations, errors, and search synonyms.
modules.search_kernel: SearchKernelService wraps legacy search sources with Admission, permission, language, ranking, and source refs.
modules.control_plane: Control Plane owns GateResult, Invariant, ShadowCompare, RollbackInstruction, release evidence, and governance evidence.
modules.evidence_graph: Evidence artifacts bind release-state, current-state, gates, screenshots, command logs, and final report.
modules.definition_registry: Definition Registry owns WorkItem, command, field, evidence, risk, ledger, surface, and projection-owner semantics.

active.name: Architecture Authority
active.reason: Rule precedence and OAM-CAB execution authority.
active.allowed_usage: Decide rule precedence and stop execution on conflicts.
active.forbidden_usage: Override current-state, API boundary, fact ownership, or release gates.

active.name: Admission Kernel
active.reason: confirmAllowed and productionAllowed need a central source.
active.allowed_usage: Evaluate visible, prepare, confirm, production, capabilities, device trust, and business state.
active.forbidden_usage: Let surface visibility grant confirm permission.

active.name: Operations Runtime
active.allowed_usage: Commit through WorkItem confirm, CommandSubmission, DomainEvent / LedgerEntry, and OperationsUnitOfWork.
active.forbidden_usage: Accept page-specific business writes or shadow runtime reads.

active.name: Compatibility Box
active.reason: Compatibility components must be registered and quarantined.
active.allowed_usage: Read, display, map, and adapt legacy material through controlled interfaces.
active.forbidden_usage: Add business write semantics, decide confirmAllowed, or grant production.

active.name: Experience Kernel
active.reason: Surface must be clear, safe, and non-authoritative.
active.allowed_usage: Render runtime decisions and recovery guidance.
active.forbidden_usage: Write business facts or expose internal command fields.

active.name: Language Kernel
active.reason: State and explanation language must be centralized.
active.allowed_usage: Provide domain terms, field labels, surface copy, error copy, and synonyms.
active.forbidden_usage: Let pages define business state semantics independently.

active.name: Search Kernel
active.reason: Search must be read-only, admitted, permission-aware, and language-aware.
active.forbidden_usage: Write facts, bypass tenant/auth filters, or degrade to contains-only search.

active.name: Control Plane
active.reason: Gate and release governance require evidence.
active.allowed_usage: Generate and inspect governance evidence, gates, and rollback instructions.
active.forbidden_usage: Directly mutate business facts or claim production GO.

active.name: Evidence Graph
active.allowed_usage: Bind gates, screenshots, logs, release evidence, and final report.
active.forbidden_usage: Fabricate pass evidence or override current-state.

active.name: Definition Registry
active.reason: Business semantics must be registered before runtime, search, or surface use.
active.allowed_usage: Resolve WorkItem definitions, fields, evidence, risk, and projection owner.
active.forbidden_usage: Keep new business semantics only in Workspace/Card or page code.

compatibility.name: ProjectionRuntime
compatibility.reason: Current projection facade remains during staged migration.
compatibility.allowed_usage: Materialize official projections and Lens snapshots.
compatibility.forbidden_usage: Become top-level architecture or write business facts.

compatibility.name: Workspace/Card prepare-confirm
compatibility.reason: Old routes are still registered as compatibility wrappers.
compatibility.allowed_usage: Forward confirm through WorkspaceCardCompatibilityAdapter and canonical runtime.
compatibility.forbidden_usage: Add new business actions or page-specific write APIs.

compatibility.name: LensQueryService legacy search
compatibility.reason: Legacy source may only feed SearchKernelService.
compatibility.forbidden_usage: Return final search directly or bypass Admission / Permission / Language.

projectionAdapters.name: ProjectionWorkspaceSearchAdapter
projectionAdapters.allowed: May provide current workspace-card projection results only as input to SearchKernelService.
projectionAdapters.forbidden: Must not be treated as final Search Kernel and must not bypass Language Kernel synonyms, permission policy, or Admission Kernel.
projectionAdapters.removalCondition: SearchKernelService owns indexing, ranking, admission, trace refs, and language explain output.

projectionAdapters.name: searchIntentHub
projectionAdapters.allowed: May adapt backend or fallback results to mobile navigation view models.
projectionAdapters.forbidden: Must not decide business production permission or business-line maturity.
